rows.verdict_le10: its melodramatic aspect was a deliberate means to an allegorical end.
rows.dek_lead: High-minded critics attacked Subarnarekha for its plot contrivances and vulgarity, but Ghatak was unfazed. It was, he said, <strong>a Brechtian exercise in epic style; its melodramatic aspect was a deliberate means to an allegorical end</st
